summary: Petition seeking approval under Section 17 of the Electricity Act, 2003 for bringing on record the appointment of Vardhman Trusteeship Private Limited/ Respondent No. 2 as the Security Trustee and for creation of security interest over the assets of Petitioner in favour of the Security Trustee, acting on behalf of and for the benefit of the Lenders (and for any subsequent transferees, assign, novatees thereof and any refinancing lenders to the Project), by way of hypothecation and equitable mortgage on the Project assets, pursuant to unattested Deed of Pledge, Declaration, Undertaking and other Financing Agreements, for the development of the Transmission Project. 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition under Section 17 of the Act seeking approval for the creation of a security interest over its movable and immovable assets in favour of Respondent No. 2, Vardhman Trusteeship Private Limited (hereinafter referred to as the "Security Trustee"), acting for and on behalf of and for the benefit of Respondent Nos. 3 to 5, namely HDFC Bank Limited, Axis Bank Limited, and Yes Bank _“(a) Approve the creation of security Interest, over the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner and to the extent as mentioned in the Facility Agreement,_ _(b) Approve any future security creation, over the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner, in favour of Security Trustee acting on behalf of and for the benefit of the Lenders and for subsequent transferees, assigns, novates thereof and any refinancing lenders of the Project, by way of hypothecation and equitable mortgage on Project assets, pursuant to the requisite Financing Agreements executed in this regard; and_ _(c) Pass such other order/orders, as may be deemed fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.”_ 4. The Petitioner has submitted that pursuant to the terms of the Facility Agreement (read with Schedule II of the Security Trustee Agreement), it is required to create the necessary security interest in favour of Vardhman Trusteeship Private Limited, _inter alia,_ as follows: - _(B) rights, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands of the Borrower in, to and under all the Clearances pertaining to the Project;_ 5. The Petitioner has submitted that, as per Article 15.2.2 of the TSA, it is entitled to create any encumbrance over all or part of the receivables or the Transmission Project Assets in favour of the lender(s) or the lenders’ representative (as defined in the TSA) as security for amounts payable under the Financing Agreements. Therefore, the Petitioner has submitted that it has the full right to create a security interest and charge in favour of Vardhaman Trusteeship Private Limited for the benefit of the lenders, subject to conditions prescribed under Article 15 of the TSA. 7. Accordingly, the Petitioner has filed the present Petition under Sections 17(3) and 17(4) of the Act seeking prior approval of the Commission for creation of security interest over its movable and immovable assets pertaining to the Project in favour of Respondent No. 2, Vardhman Trusteeship Private Limited, acting as the Security Trustee for and on behalf of the Lenders, including their subsequent transferees, 8. The Petition was called out for the hearing on 27.5.2026 after notice to the Respondents. _Vide_ the Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) for the hearing dated 27.5.2026, the Respondents were granted the opportunity to file their respective replies. 9. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that no reply has been filed by the Respondents despite notice. Upon consideration of the Petitioner’s submissions, the matter was reserved for order. Petitioner has executed a Security Trustee Agreement dated 17.6.2025 with the Security Trustee, Vardhman Trusteeship Private Limited, for the purpose of holding the security interest and the securities on behalf of and for the benefit of the Lenders, including their subsequent transferees, assigns, novatees and any refinancing lenders to the Project. - _i. the Lenders or the Lenders' Representative on their behalf shall have entered into the Financing Agreements and agreed in writing to the provisions of this Agreement; and_ _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ 16. The Petitioner and the lenders have appointed Vardhman Trusteeship Private Limited as the Security Trustee for the creation of a Security Interest over all the movable and immovable assets of the Project. In our view, Vardhman Trusteeship Private Limited needs to be given comfort for the creation of security for the benefit of the lenders, as security for the financial assistance provided by them. We, therefore, accord approval allowing the Petitioner to create a Security Interest in favour of Vardhman Trusteeship Private Limited, acting as the Security Trustee for and on behalf of the lenders, including their subsequent transferees, assigns, novatees and any refinancing lenders to the Project, by way of mortgage or any other security document over the Project assets through execution of the Indenture of Mortgage and other financing documents relating to the Project. The Petitioner is directed to submit a signed copy of the Indenture of Mortgage for the Project immediately after its execution.
title: Petition seeking approval under Section 17 of the Electricity Act, 2003 for bringing on record the appointment of Vardhman Trusteeship Private Limited/ Respondent No. 2 as the Security Trustee and for creation of security interest over the assets of Petitioner in favour of the Security Trustee, acting on behalf of and for the benefit of the Lenders (and for any subsequent transferees, assign, novatees thereof and any refinancing lenders to the Project), by way of hypothecation and equitable mortgage on the Project assets, pursuant to unattested Deed of Pledge, Declaration, Undertaking and other Financing Agreements, for the development of the Transmission Project.
